subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should `message(action=send)` resolve selected-model `responsePrefix` variables such as provider, model, modelFull, and thinkingLevel, and what attempt context should it use for sends outside the normal reply pipeline?
rationale: Current main intentionally skips unresolved selected-model templates on tool sends to avoid leaking literal placeholders, so an automated fix would choose a runtime contract rather than repair a narrow implementation bug.

options.title: Propagate live-attempt context
options.body: Pass current attempt provider/model/modelFull/thinkingLevel into visible message-tool sends and skip or diagnose prefixing only when no live attempt context exists.

options.title: Document reply-only variables
options.body: Treat selected-model variables as unsupported for message-tool sends and update docs/tests so static and identity prefixes are the intended tool-send behavior.

options.title: Keep design tracker open
options.body: Leave the partial fix in place while maintainers design a broader model-attribution surface before changing message-tool egress again.

recommendation.title: Propagate live-attempt context
recommendation.body: Pass current attempt provider/model/modelFull/thinkingLevel into visible message-tool sends and skip or diagnose prefixing only when no live attempt context exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently implemented and documented the current partial behavior and its explicit selected-model scope boundary.
